infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: GRIDGO shares your position only during a delivery job you accepted: with the shop until pick-up, then with the client until delivery. Sharing stops when the job ends.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: GRIDGO uses the camera for pickup and delivery proof photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: GRIDGO needs your photos so you can set a profile picture and attach a proof photo when the camera is unavailable.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: GRIDGO never asks to follow you all the time. It shares your position only during a delivery job you accepted, keeps sharing while you switch apps during that job with the blue location indicator showing, and stops when the job ends.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: GRIDGO never asks to follow you all the time. It shares your position only during a delivery job you accepted, keeps sharing while you switch apps during that job with the blue location indicator showing, and stops when the job ends.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: GRIDGO does not read your motion or fitness activity. It only uses your location, during a delivery job you accepted.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: GRIDGO does not use Face ID. Your sign-in stays in the phone's secure storage.
